variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Text resolved by the tile wave.

variables.label: Columns
variables.description: Number of columns in the wordmark tile grid.

variables.label: Wave stagger
variables.description: Delay between tile reveals in spatial wave order.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far the element is offset before it slides home: 14px, 28px or 52px.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: up starts the element below its resting place so it rises in, down starts it above so it drops in.

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Starting blur radius, from a light haze to a full smear.

variables.label: Active tool
variables.description: Tool highlighted in the editor toolbar.

variables.label: Path label
variables.description: Name shown for the active vector path.

variables.label: Rating
variables.description: Target rating in star units from 0 to 5.

variables.label: Star count
variables.description: Number of stars shown in the row.

variables.label: Show value
variables.description: Show or hide the synchronized numeric rating.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Three comma-separated labels shown in path order.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Beam and active-element color.

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Bold note title. A | breaks the line.

variables.label: Lines
variables.description: Pipe-separated body lines, typed one after another.
variables.default: my videos sucked|my tools cost $$$|and re-edits never end.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Typing speed multiplier. 1 is the measured human rhythm.

variables.label: Regions
variables.description: Comma-separated region labels; 2 to 4 are used, one translucent mask + bracket + mono chip each.

variables.label: Flood at
variables.description: Seconds from mount start when the segmentation pass begins. Clamped so the pass and any exit stay inside the clip.

variables.label: Flicker
variables.description: Deterministic 2-frame HUD luminance toggle riding the flood pass.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Mask, bracket, and chip color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the labeled read holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight color used throughout the app UI.

variables.label: App title
variables.description: Title displayed in the app header.

variables.label: Actions
variables.description: Comma separated labels for the pills that fan out under the button. Up to six.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Colour of the round button behind the white bars.

variables.label: Button size
variables.description: Diameter of the round button in pixels. The bars scale with it.

variables.label: Screenshot
variables.description: Your own screen capture. Leave empty for the built-in dashboard.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Where the offset the timeline drives points.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Scales the travel offset, so the words cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Words
variables.description: The words themselves, split on spaces, one span and one stagger step each.

variables.label: Chart type
variables.description: Chart form the data builds into.

variables.label: Data
variables.description: Comma-separated numbers; the chart lands exactly on these values.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Comma-separated labels, one per datum.

variables.label: Emphasize
variables.description: Index of the datum that takes the accent and the value callout. Clamped to the data range.

variables.label: Unit
variables.description: Suffix appended to every displayed value.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color used by the emphasized datum and its callout.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Proof stats end on the still hold, so the default is none.

variables.label: Item count
variables.description: Number of tiles in the responsive grid.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Delay between consecutive tile entrances.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Direction each tile travels into its resting position.

variables.label: Sketch
variables.description: Authored preset sketch to draw. Ignored when the strokes slot holds custom paths.

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Short line shown after the sketch completes.

variables.label: Pen
variables.description: Show or hide the pen nib actor.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by strokes marked data-ink=accent (one highlight stroke in each preset).

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: How the completed lockup leaves. none holds the final frame.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Text displayed as the headline.

variables.label: Accent word index
variables.description: Zero-based word index to color. Out of range leaves the headline unaccented.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color applied to the selected word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Drop shadow cast under the headline. On by default; set false for a flat matte look.

variables.label: Tint
variables.description: Marker colour. Green, blue and violet ride --brand, --accent and --accent-2.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Height of the marker band behind the text, as a share of the font size.

variables.label: Origin
variables.description: Edge the marker grows out of as the scale variable runs from 0 to 1.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Short phrase that builds one word at a time.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer phrases shrink to stay inside the frame.

variables.label: Entry offset
variables.description: Horizontal distance each new word travels before it lands.

variables.label: Color
variables.description: Text color for the full phrase.

variables.label: Font weight
variables.description: Weight used by every word in the phrase.

syncPoints.description: Calibrated to the default three-word text; custom word counts change the lock time.

variables.label: Pivot
variables.description: Where the content hangs from. The swing rotates about this point, so the top edge stays pinned.

variables.label: Amplitude
variables.description: How far the first swing reaches before it settles. Every later swing scales with it, so the pendulum still comes to rest upright.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Which side the pendulum swings in from: right lifts the first swing clockwise, left mirrors it.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Content colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Charset
variables.description: Density ramp, dark to light. A leading space keeps dark cells empty.

variables.label: Grid
variables.description: Final cell pitch the resolve lands on.

variables.label: Resolve at
variables.description: Seconds from mount start when the coarse-to-fine resolve begins.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Glyph ink: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the fine render holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Rows
variables.description: Number of logo rows in the wall.

variables.label: Columns
variables.description: Number of logo columns in the wall.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Delay between consecutive logo cell entrances.

variables.label: Icon pair
variables.description: Before and after icon states used by the morph.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color applied as the morph completes.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Line that types itself out character by character.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Colour of the text and the caret: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Caret
variables.description: Caret shape: a thin rule, a terminal-style block, or no caret at all.

variables.label: Progress
variables.description: Target angular fill from 0 to 100.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Ring stroke thickness as a percent of the ring radius.

variables.label: Center label
variables.description: Numeric target shown in the center and counted in sync with the fill.

variables.label: Beat count
variables.description: Number of beat rows in the sequence.

variables.label: Interval
variables.description: Base time between consecutive beat markers.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Comma-separated beat titles, one per beat. Extra entries are ignored and missing entries fall back to Beat N.

variables.label: Width
variables.description: Sheet width in pixels.

variables.label: Radius
variables.description: Sheet corner radius.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Light is the reference near-white sheet; dark is the raised surface token.

variables.label: Flip direction
variables.description: Target end state the flip lands on.

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Optional caption under the toggle. Blank hides the line.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Toggle width as a percent of the host box width.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Text displayed in the default centered card.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: Amplitude of the ambient rotation, breathing, and light sweep.

variables.label: Split unit
variables.description: What each animated span holds. Letter staggers glyph by glyph, word keeps whole words intact.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Where each span starts. Up starts below the baseline and rises, down starts above and drops.

variables.label: Travel
variables.description: How far each span starts from its resting position, from 0.45em to 1.5em.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The line to animate. It is split on whitespace and every word gets its own span, so the stagger picks up the new words.

variables.label: Drift
variables.description: Scales the vertical offset, so the words cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Scales the blur radius the timeline drives, from a light haze to a full smear.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Particle count for the converging field.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: ltr sweeps the reveal left to right; center opens an iris from the middle outward.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Particle and monogram color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the revealed image holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Forms
variables.description: Comma-separated silhouette sequence from blob, mark, badge.

variables.label: Hold last
variables.description: True settles dead still on the final silhouette; false keeps the mass slowly breathing through the hold.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Tint of the lit facets.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. None holds the settled mass.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Uppercased A-Z 0-9 and space, clamped to 12 characters.

variables.label: Stitch
variables.description: Dash/gap scale, thread width, and jitter amplitude.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Thread color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the stitched word holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Text inside the default pill target.

variables.label: Done label
variables.description: Text beside the check once the default pill is pressed.

variables.label: Target X
variables.description: Zone center, percent of host width.

variables.label: Target Y
variables.description: Zone center, percent of host height.

variables.label: Press at
variables.description: Seconds from mount start when the press begins.

variables.label: Cursor
variables.description: Pointer tone.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color for the click rings and the confirmation check.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: How the frame leaves. None holds the pressed state.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of the words, from a caption-scale line to a full display card.

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Scales the blur radius the timeline drives, so the focus pull starts as a light haze or a full smear.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Headline copy. Every whitespace-separated word becomes one staggered span.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of every word in pixels, clamped to 24-160. Line height stays proportional.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Base word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the shimmer the second timeline step sweeps across the words.

variables.label: Card count
variables.description: Number of cards rendered in the rail.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Active color used by the focused card and contact circle.

variables.label: Card label prefix
variables.description: Text placed before each card number.

variables.label: Detail text
variables.description: Stat shown in the detail chip at the center of the reveal.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Headline revealed around the focused detail.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight color used across the composed scene.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Shared accent color used by all three product screens.

variables.label: Orientation
variables.description: Which way the rule runs, and so which way the reveal travels.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Size of the rule across its short edge, from a 1px hairline to a 4px bar.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Colour of the revealed fill: neutral grey, the theme accent, or the warning hue.

variables.label: Action line
variables.description: Two to four word action that closes the film.

variables.label: Button label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the single CTA capsule.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color used by the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts (this primitive closes films).

variables.label: Overshoot
variables.description: Strength passed to the back.out entrance curve.

variables.label: Starting scale
variables.description: Scale at the start of the entrance.

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the badge.

variables.label: From scale
variables.description: Multiplies the authored card footprint, clamped 0.5 to 1.5.

variables.label: Expand at
variables.description: Seconds after mount when the card grows into the panel.

variables.label: Register
variables.description: Morph feel. Snappy is faster with a settle capped at 1.02 of the target rect.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the settled panel holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Curtain tone
variables.description: Curtain color.

variables.label: Pelmet
variables.description: Static valance framing the top of the stage.

variables.label: Spotlight
variables.description: Soft glow blooming over the stage as the curtains part.

variables.label: Wash
variables.description: Colour of the mid-transition frame. Paper resolves through --hf-fade-through-wash, accent rides --accent.

variables.label: Strength
variables.description: How far the wash covers at its peak. 1 is a full flash, 0.3 a light veil.

variables.label: Shape
variables.description: Flat fills the frame evenly, bloom concentrates the wash in the centre.

variables.label: Nucleus label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the fixed center nucleus.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by the nucleus, rings, and satellite markers.

variables.label: Satellites
variables.description: Number of orbiting copy chips.

variables.label: Titles
variables.description: Comma-separated card titles (1 to 5 cards).

variables.label: Bodies
variables.description: Comma-separated body lines matched to titles by index. Blank entries hide that body line.
variables.default: Pipeline started for main,All 42 checks green,Now serving version 2.4

variables.label: Expand
variables.description: Index of the focus card in the titles list. -1 focuses the newest card (top of the stack).

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated per-card arrival times in seconds. Blank entries use the default rhythm.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent token family used by the icon dots.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: How the stack leaves the frame. Default none: the hold ends the film.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Bubble width in pixels; dots and tail scale with it.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Dark is the reference iOS bubble; light suits bright chat grounds.

variables.label: Tail
variables.description: The two shrinking circles anchoring the bubble to the sender side.

variables.label: Cards
variables.description: Number of cards in the stack, 3 to 5.

variables.label: Shuffle cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds from mount start; each cue throws the back card to the front. Cues inside a running throw redirect it mid-flight, velocity preserved. Empty keeps the default rhythm.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Active-card ring color from the contract token map.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the settled stack holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The word whose variable-font axes flex.

variables.label: Axis
variables.description: Which variable-font axes animate: weight, width, or both.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Seconds between per-character flex starts, clamped 0 to 0.25.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Word color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the carved word holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Type
variables.description: Which message form arrives.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Bubble text, or the emoji row for the Emoji type.

variables.default: HyperFrames — Write HTML, render pixel-perfect video

variables.label: Card domain
variables.description: Link-card domain line (Link card type only).

variables.label: Tail
variables.description: The bubble tail anchoring the message to its side.

variables.label: Delivered
variables.description: The receipt under a sent message.

variables.label: Chip count
variables.description: Number of tasks and notifications crowding the center.

variables.label: Center label
variables.description: Text inside the calm central subject. Blank hides the text.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: How tightly and quickly the chips crowd the center.

variables.description: Mark color: quiet muted or full-contrast ink.

variables.label: Exit

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Dot size and spacing across the grain field.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent token family used to color the dots and luminance wash.

variables.label: Panels
variables.description: How many torn paper scraps cover the frame.

variables.description: Color per scrap. Mixed seeds a different tone per scrap for a real scrapbook mix.

variables.description: Outward sends each scrap away from the frame center. Scatter sends every scrap the same general direction with seeded variance.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the highlighted words. gold is the original.

variables.label: Framing
variables.description: Air the camera leaves around the written block, so the words land larger or smaller in frame.

variables.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.description: Comma-separated cursor names, in order.

variables.description: Height of the marker band behind the text, as a share of the font size.

variables.label: Origin
variables.description: Edge the marker grows out of as the scale variable runs from 0 to 1.

variables.description: Short phrase that builds one word at a time.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer phrases shrink to stay inside the frame.

variables.label: Entry offset
variables.description: Horizontal distance each new word travels before it lands.

variables.label: Color
variables.description: Text color for the full phrase.

variables.label: Font weight
variables.description: Weight used by every word in the phrase.

syncPoints.description: Calibrated to the default three-word text; custom word counts change the lock time.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Headline copy. Every whitespace-separated word becomes one staggered span.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of every word in pixels, clamped to 24-160. Line height stays proportional.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Base word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the shimmer the second timeline step sweeps across the words.

variables.label: Detail text
variables.description: Stat shown in the detail chip at the center of the reveal.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Headline revealed around the focused detail.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight color used across the composed scene.

variables.label: Action line
variables.description: Two to four word action that closes the film.

variables.label: Button label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the single CTA capsule.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color used by the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts (this primitive closes films).

variables.label: Panels
variables.description: How many torn paper scraps cover the frame.

variables.label: Paper tone
variables.description: Color per scrap. Mixed seeds a different tone per scrap for a real scrapbook mix.

variables.label: Spread
variables.description: Outward sends each scrap away from the frame center. Scatter sends every scrap the same general direction with seeded variance.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Text whose words or characters rise into place.

variables.label: Split
variables.description: Animate the text as words or individual characters.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds (from mount start) for each unit landing. Empty keeps the authored cascade rhythm.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract accent token used for the text color.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the line holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Right-card tint, right badge, and right ambient glow color.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. None holds the final spread.

variables.label: Before label

variables.label: After label
variables.description: Chip shown on the revealed after panel. Blank hides the chip.

variables.label: Resting split
variables.description: Divider resting position after the wipe lands.

variables.label: Wipe start

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Divider handle and after chip color.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. None holds the final comparison frame.

variables.label: From text
variables.description: The outgoing label, on screen before the swap.

variables.label: To text
variables.description: The incoming label, on screen after the swap. It rests hidden until the timeline reveals it.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Scales the vertical offset the timeline drives, so each label covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Label colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Start value
variables.description: First value shown by the count.

variables.label: End value
variables.description: Final value where the count lands.

variables.label: Prefix
variables.description: Optional text shown before the value.

variables.label: Suffix
variables.description: Optional text shown after the value.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by the count.

variables.label: Glow
variables.description: Optional soft accent glow under the count. Off by default.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the landed value holds until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Spin
variables.description: How many full 0 to 9 revolutions each column adds before it lands, which is how far the reel travels in the same time.

variables.label: Spacing
variables.description: Gap between the digit columns.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Digit colour: inherit keeps the surrounding text colour, ink suits light frames, paper suits dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Split position
variables.description: Target resting position of the comparison divider.

variables.label: Orientation
variables.description: Axis and direction used by the comparison wipe.

variables.label: Before label
variables.description: Caption shown on the base before panel.

variables.label: After label
variables.description: Caption shown on the revealed after panel.

variables.label: Value
variables.description: The number itself. Every character becomes its own span, so the stagger still lands character by character.

variables.label: Unit
variables.description: Small suffix printed after the number. Pass an empty string to drop it.

variables.label: Lift
variables.description: Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the characters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Number colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Action line
variables.description: Primary action statement shown above the CTA.

variables.label: Button label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Microcopy
variables.description: Supporting detail shown below the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Fill color used by the CTA capsule.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Text centered in the camera frame.

variables.label: Push intensity
variables.description: Final camera scale reached by the push.

variables.label: Wordmark

variables.label: Tagline
variables.description: Optional tagline that settles beneath the wordmark. Empty hides it.

variables.label: URL

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color used by the brand period at the end of the wordmark.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Films end on the still hold, so the default is none.

variables.label: Wordmark

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Mono caption under the rule. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Kicker
variables.description: Small mono label above the wordmark. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Rule

variables.description: Contract color carried by the hairline rule.

variables.label: Exit

variables.label: Headline

variables.description: Distance and rotation of the scattered glyphs.

variables.label: Exit

variables.description: Strength of the glow and saturation pulse.

variables.label: Text
